expiring_7.name: Membership ends in {{days}} days
expiring_7.default: Hi {name}, your membership ({plan}) ends in {days} days, on {end_date}. Visit {gym} to renew it.

expiring_3.name: Membership ends in {{days}} days
expiring_3.default: Hi {name}, only {days} days left on your membership ({plan}): it ends on {end_date}. See you at {gym} to renew!

expiring_1.name: Membership ends tomorrow
expiring_1.default: Hi {name}, your membership ({plan}) ends tomorrow ({end_date}). Renew it today so your training doesn't stop. {gym}

expired.name: Membership ended
expired.default: Hi {name}, your membership ({plan}) ended on {end_date}. We miss you! Renew it whenever you're ready. {gym}

installment_due.name: Installment due
installment_due.default: Hi {name}, a reminder that an installment of {amount} is due on {due_date}. Thank you! {gym}

debt.name: Debt reminder
debt.default: Hi {name}, you still have {amount} to pay at {gym}. Please pay it on your next visit. Thank you!

spa_booking.name: Spa booking
spa_booking.default: Hi {name}, a reminder of your spa booking: {service}, {date} at {time}, at {branch}. See you soon!

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.default: Hi {name}, welcome to {gym}! Your member number is {number}. Message us any time if you have a question.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.default: Happy birthday, {name}! Everyone at {gym} wishes you a year full of health and happiness.
